entities.summary: Jean-Crispin Kimbeni Ki Kanda is a Congolese Catholic prelate who serves as Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Kisantu, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since 11 June 2022. Before that, from 29 June 2020 until 11 June 2022, he was Auxiliary Bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kinshasa. He was appointed bishop on 29 June 2020 by Pope Francis. He was consecrated and installed at Kinshasa, on 10 October 2020. He served as Titular Bishop of Dragonara concurrently while auxiliary bishop.
